outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual data point overlay.
The scatter/bar plot of inhibition zone percentages shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots overlaid for each biological replicate, as stated in the caption and visible in the figure.
Panel C consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Fluorescence intensity plot shows mean ± SEM with individual cell values overlaid as open yellow circles.
Fluorescence intensity plot (log scale) shows mean ± SEM with individual cell values overlaid as open blue circles.
Panel F shows super-resolution PALM localization images of representative single cells, not an averaged summary plot.
Number of clusters per cell is shown as mean ± SEM with individual cell values overlaid as gray dots.
Cluster size plot (log scale) shows mean ± SEM with individual cluster values overlaid as gray dots.
Proportion of molecules in clusters per cell is shown as mean ± SEM with individual cell values overlaid as gray dots.
